hints.title: Start small
hints.body: The smallest remaining card value has to be the first card of some run.

hints.title: Count copies
hints.body: Count how many copies of each value remain in the deck.

hints.title: Consume runs together
hints.body: If the smallest remaining value appears `k` times, each of the next `groupSize - 1` values must appear at least `k` times.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
if length(hand) is not divisible by groupSize: return false
counts = frequency table of hand
for value in sorted keys:
    amount = counts[value]
    if amount == 0: continue
    for offset from 0 to groupSize - 1:
        if counts[value + offset] < amount: return false
        counts[value + offset] -= amount
return true
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
